itemInventory: Official net.minecraft.data.Main --reports; minecraft:item registry including air and unobtainable items
recipeInventory: Every data/minecraft/recipe/**/*.json in the verified official client jar, plus explicitly labeled workstation transformations
versionSemantics: minVersion is the start of this dataset's coverage, not each item's historical introduction. maxVersion is inclusive, null means no known end. Only this release is loaded.
limitations: Item nodes represent registered item ids; potion contents, damage, banner patterns, enchantments and other components are recipe predicates or notes, not separate item nodes.
A directed edge is an ingredient's participation in the complete recipe, not an assertion that this ingredient alone crafts the output.
Workstation transformations involving arbitrary components and experience have conditional notes rather than enumerating every possible item stack.

Renaming, enchanting-table rolls, villager trading and a complete world simulation are not included. Registered structures, biome and dimension membership, structure loot and possible generation outputs are included; these describe generation rules, not the contents of any particular seed.
Vanilla only; installed mods and user datapacks are not included.

categories.source: Every nonempty official data/minecraft/tags/item JSON, with recursively resolved members and direct nested tag references

mobs.classification: EntityTypes generic class is assignable to the game's Mob base class
limitations: Possible outputs, not guaranteed drops; full loot predicates and roll/count functions are retained.
Apart from audited witch drinking potions, dynamically equipped or picked-up items are not enumerable from death loot tables.
Dynamic container contents depend on runtime contents and cannot be statically enumerated.
Gathering edges describe possible complete interactions; tools, states, variant conditions and randomness remain attached to records.
Blocks without inventory items use representative dropped-item artwork.
Villager trading, chest loot and full world transformations are not yet mapped.

limits: Registered item IDs remain nodes; potion and stew variants are explicit component predicates.
Status effect application respects entity immunity, difficulty and other trigger conditions.
Custom command/datapack item components and arbitrary equipped enchanted gear are not enumerated.
Nutrition and attributes are node metadata; players, damage types and attributes are not additional nodes.

interactions.source: SHA1-verified Java 26.3 registry mappings, default item components, item/block/entity tags and all referenced block transformers, plus version-pinned Java interaction audits
limitations: No new structure, biome, action, player, dimension or chest-loot nodes.
World interactions are finite audited triggers, not exhaustive world/AI simulation or arbitrary customized stacks.
Mob equipment/pickup ability is not inferred for items lacking explicit allowed-entity restrictions.
Natural spawning environments, arbitrary spawner/trial-spawner entity data, lightning and command spawning are excluded.
Inventory-less block targets absent from the existing graph are omitted and listed explicitly.
Bonemeal links express valid target types; world-dependent success and generated feature outputs are not simulated.
No new plant, biome, structure, profession or player nodes. Growth targets absent from the existing graph remain omitted.

mobBehaviors.scope: Finite audited mob conversions, predators, repellents, pollination, incubation, temptation, Cat resting and Copper Golem behavior. Runtime states are predicates; no new nodes.

limitations: XP rewards remain conditional; customized enchantment/advancement rewards, player deaths and trade offers are not enumerated.
Outputs describe possible vanilla generation, subject to placement, terrain, height and climate checks; they do not guarantee presence in a particular seed.
Empty air and template marker blocks are omitted. The Void is linked via its Overworld flat-world preset, not normal terrain.

structure:minecraft:end_podium_inactive.runtimeTrigger: Initial central End fight arena; no exit portal until the dragon is defeated

structure:minecraft:end_podium_active.runtimeTrigger: EndDragonFight activates the central exit portal after a dragon is defeated

structure:minecraft:end_gateway_delayed.runtimeTrigger: EndDragonFight creates a gateway at a selected position approximately 96 blocks from the central arena after a dragon kill

limitations: Possible outputs across structure variants, not a seed-specific simulation. Jigsaw depth and connector names are checked, including terminal fallbacks; collision, connector orientation, distance and terrain constraints are conditional generation checks rather than simulated.
Procedural piece and processor extras were audited against this version's game code; adding another version requires a new audit.
Dynamic items picked up by residents and copied surrounding terrain are not enumerable fixed structure contents.
Icons are representative game-block emblems, not full structure previews.
The optional world-setting bonus chest is not represented; this is a starter item container, not biome decoration or a registered structure.
